name: bandit.r033_registered_smoke_proximity_dedup_mcw
description: R-033 paired-site proximity successor. It evaluates exactly one native active smoke source at the staffed camp's own OMT: first positive smoke signal lead creation, then unchanged-source dedup. Only a matching signal-origin smoke lead counts; terrain opportunities are confounds.

proof_gates.label: R-033 proximity smoke reaches one current source-bound live session

steps.label: operate_r033_registered_smoke_proximity_dedup
steps.objective: Before input bind paired sites/member 18 and the sole smoke source at [3374,983,0], OMT [140,40,0]. First cadence must create zero sites and create a smoke-signal lead matching channel smoke, source OMT [140,40,0], and signal origin; ignore terrain opportunities. Leave source unchanged. Only after exact durable lead identity/count/hash is saved may the second cadence establish unchanged/dedup for that same signal lead.
proof_targets: paired registered-site identities and observer identity
verified terrain/source coordinates, scanner range, and camp/source OMT coincidence
zero site creation at first cadence
first exact smoke-only R008 and positive source-matched callback/lead
second exact source-matched unchanged lead identity/dedup
sound/light absence and filtered signal-lead count/hash at both boundaries
authority: advertised native actions and worker-chosen bounded waits
invariants: registration and item activation are zero-credit
terrain-opportunity leads never count as a signal result
do not treat presentation as callback evidence

evidence_contract.claim: one source-bound R-033 run supplies only native smoke-to-matching-signal-lead and same-source dedup facts after paired sites are registered
evidence_contract.failure_rule: a first-cadence site creation, conflating source, missing binding, no positive source-matched callback, or changed signal lead identity leaves the claim unproved
